primaryIntent: Get IT support, endpoints, infrastructure and deployment handled
title: IT Services — business IT support, endpoints, infrastructure and deployment
description: IT Services from ThatDeveloperGuy LLC: support desk, workstations and endpoints, network and infrastructure, deployment and maintenance.
heading: IT Services
summary: Support today, a brighter tomorrow: the systems your people use every day, kept running.

sections.heading: System status
sections.body: The status board in the room is an illustration, not live telemetry. Real monitoring is scoped per client and reported through agreed channels.

sections.heading: IT support
sections.body: A service desk with a named person behind it. Requests are tracked from first contact to closure.

sections.heading: Workstations and endpoints
sections.body: Laptops, desktops and the accounts on them: provisioning, updates, replacement and retirement.

sections.heading: Network and infrastructure
sections.body: Racks, switches, servers and the cloud services that replaced some of them — designed, documented and maintained.

sections.heading: Deployment and maintenance
sections.body: Planned rollouts with a tested rollback, and maintenance windows that are announced before they happen.

sections.heading: IT service process
sections.body: Plan, configure, deploy, maintain, improve — the five drawers of the tool cart, in that order.

serviceDetail.problem: The systems people use every day — laptops, accounts, the office network, the servers or cloud services behind them — need someone to answer the phone, keep them patched, replace what breaks and roll out changes without surprises. Small organizations usually have nobody whose job that is.
audience: Small and medium businesses with 5 to 250 people
City, county and district offices that run their own IT
Prime contractors that need workplace IT covered on a delivery
included: A service desk with a named person behind it; requests tracked from first contact to closure
Workstations and endpoints: provisioning, updates, replacement and retirement
Network and infrastructure: design, documentation and maintenance of what you run
Deployment and maintenance: planned rollouts with a tested rollback and announced maintenance windows
deliverables: A request log you can read, with each request's state and owner
An inventory of the machines, accounts and services in scope, kept current
A change record for every rollout: what changed, when, how it was checked, how to roll back
excluded: Hardware purchasing on your behalf unless written into the engagement
24/7 support or guaranteed response times unless written into a specific agreement
Software development and website work — those are separate capabilities with their own scope

evidence.claim: ThatDeveloperGuy LLC has operated as a business since 2017.
evidence.support: Founding date on the organization record.

evidence.claim: The organization operates 218 live websites for clients across its hosting.
evidence.support: Live count of every candidate hostname on the organization record, 2026-09-12.
To be supplied and approved by the owner before publication.

process.detail: Inventory what you run and agree what is in scope.
Standard builds, accounts and monitoring set up on the systems in scope.
Rollouts in announced windows with a tested rollback.
Patching, replacements and the service desk on an agreed schedule.
A periodic review of what broke, what was slow, and what to change.
